frozenBefore: any A2/A3 run on the Far challenge set; gold context text is never used to build a query

cases.included: exportStatus VALID and contextDistance Far-topic or Far-video (5 cases: 2001/stt-index-4, 2002/stt-index-0, 2002/stt-index-17, 2002/stt-index-1963, 2003/stt-index-245)

types.PREVIEW: target in the opening preview; gold context is the later full scene (2001/4, 2002/0, 2002/17)
types.A0_PAGE_BOUNDARY: gold context close in time but cut off by the A0 reading page (2002/1963, 2003/245)

cases.goldLabelSource: AI draft T2 (gpt-6-luna), provisional reference label until human verification

documents.set: every segment of the frozen transcript except the target
documents.model: BAAI/bge-m3 @ 5617a9f61b028005a4858fdac845db406aefb181, tools/embed_segments.py, segment raw text (target-raw-text-v1), normalized float32

scopes.FULL_VIDEO: primary: past and future segments (review after the whole video is uploaded)
scopes.PAST_ONLY: secondary: only segments with startMs below the target's (live review cannot use future context); reported for every case

queries.split: target text split after ?, . or ! followed by whitespace; pieces trimmed; empty pieces dropped
queries.splitFailure: fewer than 2 pieces means the target is unsplit; every split method then equals Q0 and the case is marked unsplit

methods.MAX: pieces; document score = max cosine over pieces
methods.RRF: pieces ranked separately; document score = sum over pieces of 1/(60 + rank), rank from 1
methods.TOPN_EQUAL: pieces ranked separately; take pieces' ranks 1, 2, ... in round-robin (piece order = text order), skip documents already taken, stop at K
methods.UNION_A3: pieces ranked separately; candidate set = union of each piece's top ceil(K / pieces), deduplicated and truncated to K in round-robin order; then always reranked by A3

ranking.tieBreak: score desc, then absolute time distance to the target, then transcript order (same as A2)
ranking.duplicates: a document appears once; its best (first) position is kept

a3.candidates: each method's own top-K candidate list at K
a3.query: Q0_RAW: target raw text; split methods: score = max reranker logit over pieces

metrics.a0Included: whether every gold context segment is in the frozen A0 provided set
metrics.recallAtK: gold segments in top K / gold segments, per case, averaged; also counted over gold segments outside A0 only (N/A when none, excluded and counted)
metrics.allContextRecallAtK: cases with every gold segment in top K / cases
metrics.goldRanks: rank of each gold segment in the full A2 ranking and in the A3 list when present
metrics.reporting: per case, per type (PREVIEW, A0_PAGE_BOUNDARY), per scope (FULL_VIDEO, PAST_ONLY), per method and K; no single pooled Far number without the type split
metrics.notInThisRun: reference-label agreement needs the judging model with each selected context; it is a later, separate run

sampleSizeNote: five cases describe failure mechanisms; they cannot establish a general advantage of any method
